sections.heading: Each {{entity_noun}} you identify qualifies only if ALL of these conditions hold for it:

rules.text: The record names the machine, or its category, in its own words about its subject — one plain step at most from what it says. Naming a thing does not name what made it or what it is made with: what the record names as a product, a part, a material, a process, a service, or a trade is that thing, not a machine, and a name for the work with a word for machines attached to it names no machine. A candidate the record does not name is not evidenced. Quote the words that name it.

children.text: The record's words include the heading the site files the subject under, and a name in any grammatical form, abbreviation, or recognisable variant is the name.
Whose {{entity_noun}} it is has no bearing here. A candidate evidenced by another party's dealings is still identified and recorded.

sections.heading: And every {{entity_noun}} you name must satisfy ALL of these:

rules.text: It names a production machine: a device, tool, or system that acts on the work itself. Equipment that keeps the operation running without acting on the work does not qualify, however necessary it is; equipment that only establishes what the work already is does not act on it; and what a machine holds, drives, or cuts with is tooling, not a machine.

It is a determinate category: not one specimen, however marked, and not a term that fixes no kind. A maker's name, a model designation, or any other mark that singles one specimen out names a unit, not a kind: report the kind the record names that specimen as, with nothing that singled it out carried into the name; where the record names no kind for it, there is no category to report. A modifier that names neither an operation nor a configuration adds no kind.
It is distinct from every other {{entity_noun}} named for the same record. Two names for the same {{entity_noun}} in different words are one, not two.

It is named at the depth the record fixes: the category the record names, with every configuration word the record supplies and none it does not. Where the record names both a kind and a narrower kind within it, the narrower one is the category. Typicality is not evidence: a step the words do not supply is never taken, however likely it is that a manufacturer like this one would have it.
